correctness.rationale: For N>=7 the five support residues are distinct and f(0)=1 with finite cyclic positive definiteness is equivalent to all sampled Fourier values P_k>=0. Taking the real even part preserves mass. Even N has antipodal sharp upper bound and a=0,b=1/2 witness. Odd 3|N has two positive-multiplier Fourier contacts yielding a+b<=1/(2cos(3pi/N)), attained at a=0. Odd 3∤N has two sharp positive dual multipliers with inverse determinant AD+C^2, exact factorization P(x)=8b(x+C)(x-A)(x-(C-A)), and an adjacent sampled-cosine gap excluding precisely the only negative interval on [-C,1]. The trigonometric identity 4A^3-3A=-C and D=4C^3-3C validates the factorization. Checked N=7 and N=9 boundary separately. Source minor prose slip says an a-coefficient cancels when the weighted combination actually yields equal a,b coefficients; the bound still follows. Independent LP agrees for all 7<=N<=150 and theta formula for 7<=N<=2000. Finite checks corroborate the analytic all-N proof.

originality.rationale: Covered by Brimkov et al. (2000) exact Lovasz theta formula for circulant C_N(1,3), independently transcribed as Eq. (12) in MathWorld and explicitly confirmed in full accessible 2003 follow-up (which credits its authors for the j=3 closed form). For Gamma_N=Cay(Z_N,{±1,±3}), the Turan mass is exactly theta(complement Gamma_N) by the translation-averaged Lovasz SDP, and theta(complement Gamma_N)=N/theta(Gamma_N) by vertex transitivity. Hence the complete three-regime claimed scalar invariant for all N>=7 is already determined, despite the different vocabulary. Full original Springer chapter inaccessible, but the identity is decisive from corroborated equation and full accessible primary follow-up; no inference of absence from snippets.

value.rationale: The support and Turan constant are mathematically natural, and the polynomial/contact proof is a readable special-case certificate. But the exact all-N invariant is already determined by the 2000 closed Lovasz theta formula for C_N(1,3), via a routine established SDP translation-averaging and vertex-transitive complement identity. The submitted extremizer/dual proof does not establish a new structural theorem, parameter boundary, or unknown exact invariant beyond that covered value; as a standalone new mathematical finding it is a recomputation under another name. This is not a rejection merely for simplicity or finiteness, but because substantive coverage predates it.
